title: Ashbury Rewards Courtesy Room Nights for Group Room Blocks Organisers
content:
The courtesy room nights in the free-reduction allowance of a Group Room Blocks reduction addendum follow the organiser's Ashbury Rewards standing:

- when the organiser's membership is active at Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite, Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite and carries at least **3** base-point stay credits posted in the last 24 months, the courtesy room nights are **4**;
- when the membership is active at Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite and carries at least **3** such credits, they are **2**;
- in every other case there are none.

**Records read.** The tier of the organiser's active Ashbury Rewards membership, and the membership's points-earning transactions whose earning source is a stay's base points, posted in the last 24 months.

### Tier and credits combined

| Active Ashbury Rewards tier | Base-point stay credits in the last 24 months | Courtesy room nights |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 3 or more | 4 |
| Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 2 or fewer | none |
| Gold Elite | 3 or more | 2 |
| Gold Elite | 2 or fewer | none |
| Member or Silver Elite | any | none |
| no active membership | — | none |

### Examples (hypothetical organisers)

- An organiser active at Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite with exactly 3 base-point stay credits in the last 24 months: 4 courtesy room nights.
- An organiser active at Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite with 5 such credits: 2 courtesy room nights.
- An organiser active at Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite whose only stay credits were posted more than 24 months ago: none.
